newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade reamined at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said.
No test on slaughter steers or heifers. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Last established market was $67.00 per cwt in a limited test on Friday.
Bids Tuesday were $65.00-$66.00, with asking prices $68.00-$70.00.

There were 6,400 head confirmed for the week to date including 7 loads or 300 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,300 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
